title: barbel object SS26
news: barbell object approaches clothing as an ongoing experiment in material, structure, and form. Operating with a deliberate sense of anonymity, the Japanese label develops garments through extensive research into fabric, construction, and finishing techniques. Contrasting elements—new and old, rough and refined, functional and expressive—are brought into careful balance through a process of continual refinement. The result is clothing with a distinct physical presence, shaped as much by curiosity and craftsmanship as by conventional notions of style.Our first season of barbell object is now available online and in stores.

title: HAVEN Horizon Bag
news: HAVEN Horizon Backpack & Horizon Messenger Bag Designed to move seamlessly through daily life, the Horizon series reflects our commitment to refined utility. Lightweight yet exceptionally durable, CORDURA Ballistic Hollofil Air provides strength, structure, and resilience without unnecessary weight.Each bag is built to endure years of travel, commuting, and exploration, resulting in a collection grounded in craftsmanship and made to accompany a lifetime of use.Available now online and in stores.

title: AUBERGE SS26
news: Founded by designer and former restaurateur Manabu Kobayashi, AUBERGE approaches clothing with the same care and depth as a finely prepared meal.Named after the traditional French inn, the brand draws from military, workwear, and tailoring archives to create garments rooted in craftsmanship, comfort, and everyday familiarity.Through custom textiles, historically informed techniques, and close collaboration with skilled artisans, familiar silhouettes are reworked with greater nuance and material richness.The result is clothing that feels timeless, considered, and refined.Our first season of AUBERGE is now available online and in stores.

title: Hender Scheme SS26
news: New arrivals from Hender Scheme introduce a range of leather footwear, bags, and small goods defined by natural textures and a considered hand.Each piece is shaped through traditional techniques and left untreated or minimally processed, allowing the leather to evolve with wear and develop a unique character.Discover Hender Scheme Spring 2026 online and in stores.

title: AURALEE SS26
news: New arrivals from AURALEE see lightweight layers with fluid silhouettes and soft structure that mark the shift into spring. Airy cottons and washed twills bring a dry, breathable hand, while ultra fine tropical wool offers a smooth drape.Discover AURALEE Spring 2026 online and at HAVEN Toronto.

title: ANCELLM SS26
news: Founded in 2021 by designer Kazuya Yamachika, ANCELLM approaches clothing as a living material, shaped as much by time as by design. Rooted in Japan’s Kojima region, the brand draws from a deep tradition of working with natural fibers, where craftsmanship becomes both process and expression.Rooted in Japan’s Kojima region, the brand draws from a deep tradition of working with natural fibers, where craftsmanship becomes both process and expression.Aging is not applied after the fact but built into each garment through layered dyeing, controlled distressing, and meticulous finishing. The result is a collection that feels already lived-in yet intentionally unresolved, inviting the wearer to continue the process over time.Our first season of ANCELLM is now available online and in stores.

title: CALE SS26
news: Cale approaches everyday wear through a lens shaped by art, design, and material sensitivity.Grounded in textile development and meticulous construction, each piece considers comfort and durability through fabric and form.Discover Cale Spring 2026 online and in stores.The Linen Duffel Jacket takes cues from vintage duffel coats, reworked in lightweight linen with leather detailing that softens over time while holding structure.Discover more Spring 2026 arrivals from HERILL online and in-stores.

title: Herill SS26
news: HERILL draws from archival silhouettes, developing each pieces in Japan using custom fabrics from historic mills. Traditional construction and craftsmanship are preserved, with fabric and proportion refined to balance texture, layering, and ease.

title: HAVEN / OTW by Vans NYC Pop-Up
news: Join us in New York for the release of the HAVEN / OTW by Vans Authentic 44 Vibram, available alongside our Spring 2026 collection.A special curation of rare prints, objects, and ephemera by Geoff Snack will be on view throughout the space, with coffee and matcha served by Elliott Foos.

title: ssstein SS26
news: Minimalist silhouettes designed with an emphasis on detail, craftmanship and materials.The ssstein Cow Leather Vintage Zip Jacket is a classic, relaxed style crafted from supple cow leather that has been treated with pigments and oils to create depth and a naturally worn character.Discover more Spring 2026 arrivals from ssstein online and in-stores.

title: HAVEN Sound Vol. 02 — Along the Coast
news: For each season, HAVEN curates a selection of music that reflects the atmosphere and environment shaping the collection. HAVEN Sound Vol. 02 continues this approach for Spring 2026, drawing inspiration from the shifting landscapes of the Pacific coastline.Ambient compositions, contemporary jazz, and minimal electronics unfold with a calm sense of movement. The playlist brings together artists including Ryuichi Sakamoto, Boards of Canada, Aphex Twin, Mammal Hands, and Nosaj Thing.Moving between stillness and subtle sounds, the selection reflects the pace of coastal landscapes,A seasonal soundtrack for the Spring 26 collection

title: Village PM SS26
news: Village PM approaches skate footwear through a technical and design-led lens.Founded in Paris, the label merges insights from skateboarding, climbing, and outdoor equipment to rethink performance and durability. Precision construction, anatomical shaping, and wrapped rubber rands deliver heightened board feel while maintaining a refined, understated aesthetic. The result is a new perspective on skate shoes—functional, considered, and rooted in contemporary skate culture.

title: BIRKENSTOCK 1774 Pre-Spring '26
news: Named after the brand’s founding year, BIRKENSTOCK 1774 represents the most refined expression of the house’s design language, elevating its heritage silhouettes through craftsmanship and specially sourced material.Each pair is made in Germany using Italian full-grain leathers, with suede and velvet linings that soften the interior. The signature moulded cork footbed is fully wrapped in nappa leather for a smoother underfoot, while proprietary hardware builds on BIRKENSTOCK’s design legacy with a more considered finish.New arrivals from BIRKENSTOCK 1774 are available now.

title: TEÄTORA Pre-Spring '26
news: TEÄTORA designs garments built for sustained wear across daily routines and travel.Grounded in research around posture, pressure, and contemporary workflows, their approach is shaped by natural movement. This season’s collection continues to deliver comfort and mobility through lightweight insulation, integrated storage, and adaptable layering suited to changing environments.New arrivals from TEÄTORA are available now online and in stores

title: HOBO SS26
news: Founded in 2004, hobo focuses on durable, well-considered carry pieces shaped by everyday movement and an independent, travel-driven spirit.This season hobo collaborates with Reproduction of Found to revisit a familiar military silhouette through a quieter, tonal approach.Available now online and in stores.

title: URU FW25
news: The latest arrivals from URU prioritize comfort and balance through relaxed proportions and considered fabrics. Each piece is shaped by a material-first approach, where texture and structure work together to support natural movement.Anchoring the delivery is the Cotton Canvas MA-1 Blouson, a familiar silhouette refined through hand-dyed cotton canvas, complemented by textured layers like the Wool Boa Zip Vest and the Half Zip Sweat.Available now online and in stores.
